notes: BiRefNet foreground matting on ComfyUI core nodes, the same graph as ComfyUI's own Remove Background (BiRefNet) blueprint: RemoveBackground outputs a foreground MASK (1 = foreground), InvertMask flips it because JoinImageWithAlpha computes alpha = 1 - mask, and SaveImage writes an RGBA PNG. No prompt and no seed. Model file: ComfyUI/models/background_removal/birefnet.safetensors (https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/BiRefNet).
